Online Capacity Expansion feature enables you to increase the storage capacity of selected virtual disk by adding a new physical disk or with the existing physical disk if the virtual disk size is less than the actual size of physical disk size. This feature enables you to add new drives to the array while the system is in use. OCE feature are not available when the disk group has more than one VD. OCE feature is not supported on RAID 50 and RAID 60 virtual disks.

OCE feature is not supported on RAID 50 and RAID 60 virtual disks.

PCIe SSDs support hot plug of devices allowing the user to add or remove a device without halting or rebooting the system. To prevent data loss when a PCIe SSDs device is being removed, it is mandatory to use the Prepare To Remove operation before physically removing a device. The CreateTargetedConfigJob() method is used to apply the pending values set by different methods under DellRAIDService class.

Indicates forcefuly doing PrepareToRemove operation or not,irrespective of the NVME sanitize status. The value is one of the following: Yes- forefully perform the operation without checking the NVMe sanitize status, No - perform the operation after checking the NVMe sanitize status and allow the operation only when the status is not in either NVME cryptographic erase in progress or failure. If this property is not given then as default the ForceRemove will be taken as ForceRemove=No

This feature enables you to add additional hard drives to the existing RAID-Level to migrate to a new RAID-level. This feature increases the data protection without any downtime. RLM feature is not available when the Disk group has more than one VD.

This version was created to add CancelBackgroundInitialization, CancelCheckConsistency, CancelRebuildPhysicalDisk, ChangePDState, ClearControllerPreservedCache, ImportForeignConfig, OnlineCapacityExpansion, PrepareToRemove, RAIDLevelMigration, RebuildPhysicalDisk, RenameVD, ReplacePhysicalDisk, SetAssetName, SetBootVD, StartPatrolRead, StopPatrolRead, UnLockSecureForeignConfig, UnassignSpare actions.
This version was created to update the allowable values NoRAID,RAID0,RAID1,RAID10,RAID5,RAID50,RAID6,RAID60 for NewRaidLevel parameter under RAIDLevelMigration action.

This version was created to update descriptions for EnableControllerEncryption,ReKey actions,Mode parameter and to update the allowable value SEKM for Mode parameter under EnableControllerEncryption action.

This version was created to add CryptographicEraseWithPSID, DisableSecurity, EnableSecurity actions and to update the allowable value LKM_TO_SEKM for Mode parameter under EnableControllerEncryption action.
This version was created to add the new input parameter ForceRemove for PrepareToRemove action.
This version was created to update descriptions for EnableSecurity action.
This version was created to rename LockVirtualDisk to SecureVirtualDisk and deprecate CheckVDValues, GetRAIDLevels, SetAssetName.
This version was created to remove LKM, DKM, LKM_TO_SEKM enums for Mode parameter.
This version was created for version control.
